name: create-atomic-install
description: Install and configure create-atomic-resources and atomic-bomb with explicit latest package resolution.

scripts.check: find bin src _tests_ -name '*.js' -print | sort | xargs -n1 node --check
scripts.pack:check: npm test && npm run check && npm pack --dry-run
scripts.predeploy: npm run pack:check && npm version patch
